title: 02. Tool Calling & MCP: Tool Design Patterns
summary: Tool Design Patterns: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  6 TOOL DESIGN PATTERNS                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  PATTERN 1: ATOMIC TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Does ONE thing perfectly. No side effects.
  
  ✅ get_stock_price(symbol)     → just gets price
  ✅ convert_currency(amount)    → just converts
  ✅ validate_email(email)       → just validates
  
  WHY: Easy to test, debug, reuse, and combine.
  
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PATTERN 2: COMPOSITE TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Combines multiple atomic tools into one logical operation.
  
  analyze_stock(symbol) internally calls:
    → get_stock_price(symbol)
    → get_company_info(symbol)
    → get_recent_news(symbol)
    → calculate_metrics(price_data)
  Returns one combined result.
  
  WHY: Fewer tool calls = lower cost, simpler agent logic.
  
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PATTERN 3: STATEFUL TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Remembers context between calls in the same session.
  
  db_query(sql)  ← remembers connection, schema
  browser_tool() ← remembers current page, session cookies
  file_tool()    ← remembers current directory, open files
  
  WHY: Avoids repeating setup on every call.
  
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PATTERN 4: ASYNC TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Non-blocking. Multiple tools can run simultaneously.
  
  [web_search]──────────────────────→ results
  [get_weather]────────────────→ weather       ← All run
  [get_stock]──────────────────────→ price      ← at same time
  
  Sequential: 3 tools × 2s each = 6 seconds
  Async:      3 tools run together = 2 seconds ✅
  
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PATTERN 5: RETRY TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Automatically retries on transient failures.
  
  Attempt 1: API call → 429 Rate Limited → wait 1s
  Attempt 2: API call → 503 Service Error → wait 2s
  Attempt 3: API call → ✅ Success!
  
  WHY: APIs fail. Networks fail. Retries = resilience.
  
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  PATTERN 6: CACHED TOOL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Don't call the same API twice for same input.
  
  Call 1: get_weather("London") → calls API → $0.001
  Cache: stores result for 10 minutes
  Call 2: get_weather("London") → cache hit! → $0.000
  
  WHY: Reduces cost, latency, and API rate limit usage.
```
